utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there on Saturday. Sam can check the list, and make sure Opal’s hinge and porch light are covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa has the rest ready, and Noah can handle pickup. Pia will check with Tess after lunch so we know who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, then we’re set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping track of the supplies, and Rosa’s list should cover what we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can you confirm Rosa’s list really has everything we need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll double-check with Rosa, but I’m treating her list as the full supply list for now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the repair drive list and make sure Opal’s hinge and porch light are covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ve got the list ready too. Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll make sure the patch list and screws are on hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll look over the list and sort out what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll post the list for the repair drive and keep the drive ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, and please make sure Jules checks who still needs help. If Bo gets there after 3:30, we should have enough hands for the patching.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll have Jules check who still needs help, and if Bo arrives after 3:30 we should still have enough hands for the patching.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, Opal. I’ll make sure the drive has what it needs by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara. The west gate hinge is loose and the porch light by the drive is flickering, so I’m glad you’ll check both.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll go check both and make sure the hinge and porch light are fixed by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring a couple tools and help after 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can help with that this week, and I’ll touch base with Vik about the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I’ll be there after 3:30 with a couple tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Ira, the repair drive still needs a few more volunteers. I let Hana know, and I’m checking who else can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oren and Vik are already helping, so I think we still need a couple more hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll keep asking around and see who else can help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli’s posting the list, and I’ve got the plumbing parts plus a couple switches covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, then Ira can handle the rest of it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, because we may need Noah to help catch up on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word and check who still needs a hand, and I’ll let Opal keep track of the follow-up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should help. Please make sure Noah knows the timing so we don’t get crossed up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Tess said they still need tools, basic supplies, and a few more volunteers to sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check around after lunch, and if I spot the posted list I’ll send you that way. If Nell sees it first, have her point Mina to it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll keep an eye out too and let Mina know if I see the list first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Ira can help once the errands are done.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Right, and once Bo gets here after 3:30, we should be okay on hands for the repair drive. Hana still wants to check the tools and paint first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, then we just need Hana to finish checking the tools and paint.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Gus said he can bring the wrench and a few tools by tomorrow morning, right? I can help catch up on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’ve got the wrench and a few tools lined up for tomorrow morning. Let’s get the repair drive caught up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, then we’re set for tomorrow morning. I’ll help catch up on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sunday at the community center still works for me. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, so we can go over it there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good. I’ve still got a couple more volunteers to line up, but I can bring the latest list on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll make sure Sunday at the community center is on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring a couple tools and help after 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, that covers the later shift. Rosa has the rest ready, Noah’s on pickup and parts, Pia will check with Tess after lunch, and Sam can take the west gate hinge and porch light.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I’ll head over after 3:30 and bring those tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a few tools and lend a wrench for the repair drive, and Noah can help catch up tomorrow if needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great, Gus. We still need basic supplies and a few more volunteers to sort donations, so I’ll pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check with Mara about the supplies, and I can still lend my wrench and help sort donations tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oren and Vik are already on it, so that should help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. I’ve got the list posted and the drive ready; Mina, Gus, and the others can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, then the rest should stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm Sam can check the list himself and help sort it out?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sam can check the list himself, and Bo can help sort it after 3:30 once he’s there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, that matches what I heard. Bo can help after 3:30, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make sure we’re covered for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps. Can Noah cover the first round too, just in case we fall behind?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can ask Noah to cover the first round if we need it. I’ll keep the supplies lined up so we have backup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word tonight and I’ll make sure everyone on my block knows the repair drive is Saturday, including Sam and Bo.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn. Please also mention the west gate hinge and the flickering porch light to Mara and Sam so they know where help is needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll make sure Mara and Sam hear about the west gate hinge and the flickering porch light tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, Eli’s posting the list, and I’m covering the plumbing parts plus a couple switches.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it, I’ll help spread the word and keep an eye out for anyone who still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good, thanks. If anyone needs parts from my side, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, Tess. I’ll make sure the drive has what it needs by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, then we’re set. I’ll check around after lunch and send Nell your way if I find the posted list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye out and make sure we’re covered by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Ira can help after she finishes her errands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can help catch up on the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would help a lot, Noah. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: If Bo gets here after 3:30, that should give us enough hands for the repair drive. Jules can spread the word and check who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can help with that this week too. I’ll touch base with Vik and get the repair drive details lined up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, then we should be covered once Bo’s there after 3:30. Let’s make sure the tools, paint, and patching hands are all set.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved again from Sunday at the community center to Monday at the school gym.
